summary: Review reports, ebooks and long-form guides for argument architecture, evidence density, redundancy and decision utility without turning the task into publication formatting.

must_inspect.why: A long artifact needs a recoverable sequence from problem to evidence to implications rather than a collection of locally plausible sections.
false_positive_guards: A reference handbook may intentionally be modular; judge against its stated reading model.

must_inspect.why: Important claims should carry proportionate evidence while low-value exposition should not dominate the artifact.
false_positive_guards: Do not require external citations for clearly framed opinion, procedure or first-party experience.

must_inspect.why: Long-form trust erodes when the same point is repackaged repeatedly without new information.
false_positive_guards: Strategic repetition can be useful when the audience is expected to skim; identify whether each repeat adds retrieval value.

required_evidence: complete manuscript or explicit sampled scope
false_positive_guards: Do not claim document-wide redundancy from a short excerpt.
